title: 2012 Topps Prime Retail #65 Lamar Miller Miami Dolphins Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2012 Topps Prime sports trading card features Lamar Miller, a rookie player for the Miami Dolphins in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the retail parallel/variety set and has the card number 65. It also belongs to the base set and is a great addition for any football fan's collection. 

The card is manufactured by Topps and does not include an autograph. Its features include the parallel/variety aspect and its rookie status. This card is a must-have for any collector or fan of Lamar Miller or the Miami Dolphins.
